LESSON: VOLUME

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: MEASUREMENT
Topic 2.3: Volume
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Volume, part of MEASUREMENT in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How are the volume of cubes and cuboids applicable in real life? 2. How do you derive the formula of a cube?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Volume together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: A learner organise own learning as they play digital games involving volumes.

● Digital literacy: A learner interacts with digital devices with assistive technology to play digital games involving volumes.

Creativity and imagination: A learner develops connecting skills as they use cubes to make cuboids and calculate volume.

Values:
● Respect: A learner displays patience as they take turns in placing and counting square cut outs in pairs or groups.

● Responsibility: A learner takes care of learning materials used.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

• Languages: A learner develops communication skills as they use new terms related to volume in discussions.
